about: Key material, as SPEC §9.2 refuses it ("any cell, any string member of the manifest or of a message, and any media file that decodes as a private key — PKCS #8 or SEC1, in DER or PEM"): each case is bytes (`hex`) or text (`text`), and whether a media file of those bytes holds a private key. Detection reads leniently, as a lenient decoder would (CW-07, R38): a base64 word forgives its padding, either alphabet and a last character with a spare bit set, and a DER length may take any definite form of up to four octets. The one list: the core's a_media_file_is_key_material_in_der_or_pem (crates/pact-identity/src/export/mod.rs), the Go port's TestAMediaFileIsKeyMaterialInDEROrPEM (go/export_zip_test.go) and the parity cases of media_holds_private_key (js/cases/export.mjs) read it. Written once from the seed library's keys (seed "key-material/ed25519", "key-material/sec1", and js/cast.mjs's bharat.root for P-256), and data from then on.
